SELECT d.id, d.department_id, dp.name AS department_name, d.doctor_no, d.real_name, d.title, d.specialty, d.introduction, d.avatar_url, d.consultation_fee, d.status FROM doctor d JOIN department dp ON dp.id = d.department_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1
AND d.department_id = #{departmentId}
AND ( d.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.doctor_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY d.id

SELECT d.id, d.department_id, dp.name AS department_name, d.doctor_no, d.real_name, d.title, d.specialty, d.introduction, d.avatar_url, d.consultation_fee, d.status FROM doctor d JOIN department dp ON dp.id = d.department_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1
SELECT * FROM doctor_schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT id, schedule_id, slot_no, start_time, end_time, status FROM schedule_slot WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY slot_no
